card.title: Is It a Power of Two?

a1.cap: Return true if the integer n equals 2^k for some integer k ≥ 0.
a1.say: Return true if the integer n equals 2 to the power of k for some integer k greater than or equal to 0.

lines: Return true if the integer n equals 2^k for some integer k ≥ 0.

a1.cap: For example, with n = 16, the answer is true.
a1.say: For example, with n equals 16, the answer is true.

a1.cap: A positive power of two has exactly one 1 bit. Clearing the lowest 1 bit with n & (n − 1) must therefore leave zero.
a1.say: A positive power of two has exactly one 1 bit. Clearing the lowest 1 bit with n and (n minus 1) must therefore leave zero.
